prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption and redesign changes, as only one test has been completed so far.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Sync Notice: Add a clear account sync hint on the sign-in screen reminding returning users to sign in with their original provider to prevent losing pets. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or being reset after signing in again with a different account.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Quick Controls Overview Screen: Add a new screen at the end of onboarding displaying visual quick-reference cards for controlling, hiding, and interacting with the desktop pet. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide the pet, and finish step conversion is 64.8%.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Display Check Wait Screen: Enhance the waiting screen with progress indicators, time estimates, and display permission guidance while desktop pet assets generate. (why: Home target step has high drop-off and very long average wait times (median 201s, mean 2336s), plus 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] Interactive Story Scroll Starter Path: Redesign the intro story screen using a story_scroll layout featuring animated mascot assets and clear path entry points. (why: The choose_path target step has a 514s mean duration, indicating users stall or get distracted before selecting a path.)
4: [sign_in, layout] Sign-In Card Layout with Troubleshooting Hint: Reframe the sign-in screen into a structured card layout with step counters and a troubleshooting hint for frozen login prompts. (why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% with a high mean time of 567s, and 2 support emails noted sign-in screens stalling or missing.)
5: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Companion Showcase Redesign: Redesign home_intro into a stage layout featuring a live mascot celebration animation and companion setup checklist. (why: Finish step conversion sits at 64.8%, and overall onboarding completion is only 17.8%.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Path Selection Guided Checklist Layout: Convert the choose_path screen into a checklist layout with a visible step counter to make decision-making immediate. (why: Choose_path step has a huge difference between median (8s) and mean (514s) time, showing extreme user paralysis.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop Launch Notification Opt-In: Add a notify-when-ready option and rotating tip carousel to the waiting screen while background companion setup finishes. (why: The waiting phase in home step takes a very long mean time (2336s), causing users to leave the desktop app unattended.)
